summary.text: Dragon Commander Ye Cha is a rank seven immortal zombie, one of three leaders of Dark Flow Giant City's Zombie Alliance branch, who raises yaksha octopuses in his own immortal aperture.

claims.text: When Fang Yuan first meets him, Yin Liu Gong sits at the center seat with Dragon Commander Ye Cha on his left, sitting upright with a ruthless expression and pale sharp fangs, one of three rank seven immortal zombies stationed at Dark Flow Giant City. He asks questions of a recently arrived immortal zombie with steel-like words that burst forth a strong wave of killing intent, a force built from his experiences as a lone cultivator who joined the Imperial Court contest and used opportunities inside to accumulate his foundation.

Among the three leaders overseeing Dark Flow Giant City, Dragon Commander Ye Cha holds a high status and concerns himself with reputation. He declines assignments that conflict with his interests, such as a yaksha octopus task, citing prior plans to attend an important auction where certain items have long held his focus. When another leader offers him contribution points toward a dangerous ancient desolate beast mission, he puts forward six hundred contribution points of his own, influencing enough rank six immortal zombies to make the risky task worthwhile.
Yin Liu Gong, Dragon Commander Ye Cha, and Huang Quan Weng take turns watching over the entrance to Earth Trench, the desolate belly that Zombie Alliance strictly guards.
His reputation as a leader means he bears responsibility for subordinates’ actions and cannot retreat from challenge without losing his standing.

After Old Ancestor Xue Hu ransacks the immortal zombie graveyard, Dragon Commander Ye Cha and the other two leaders close Dark Flow Giant City completely, showing a defensive stance. When Blazing Heaven Demoness returns and learns of an undiscovered immortal zombie hiding in Earth Trench, the three leaders admit failure and accept blame in unison, unable to conceal their uneasiness and agitation.

Dragon Commander Ye Cha uses his own immortal aperture to raise large numbers of yaksha octopuses, a distinction that gained him a reputation and sparked curiosity among other immortal zombies. Immortal zombies are thought to carry dead apertures filled with death energy, making it puzzling how he achieves this cultivation.

While exploring Earth Trench, he demonstrates patience and experience, commanding scouting personally, arranging defensive formations, and allocating tasks to subordinates as they move deeper into desolate beast territories.
